mainEntity.name: How do I choose an AEO provider for my restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an AEO provider for your restoration company, look for agencies with a proven track record in the home services or restoration industry. Evaluate their understanding of your specific services (water, fire, mold), their approach to content strategy, and their reporting methods. Request case studies or client testimonials. Ensure they prioritize ethical white-hat tactics and can demonstrate how they measure AEO success beyond basic keyword rankings, focusing on featured snippets and answer box placements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an AEO provider with restoration industry experience, a strong content strategy, ethical practices, and clear reporting on featured snippet and answer box placements.
